describe.description: The creature is shown in a three-quarter front-side view facing to the right, standing on a flat light surface with a faint shadow under its feet. It has a stout, low-slung, quadrupedal body with an arched back and a thick tapering tail extending to the left and partially out of frame. The dorsal surface from the back of the neck over the back and onto the base of the tail is covered in overlapping large rounded scales that are dark brown-gray in the center with lighter tan edges, arranged in diagonal rows. The ventral body, head, limbs, and underside of the tail are pale pinkish-beige with wrinkled, smooth, fleshy skin showing horizontal folds along the torso and limbs. The head at the front right is broad, flat and blunt-snouted with large round dark eyes with pale irises, small nostrils, and a wide slightly upturned mouth. Six feathery pink to reddish external gills with fine filamentous branches project from the sides of the head and neck, three per side. The four limbs are thick and columnar, splayed slightly outward, ending in broad five-toed feet with small dark claws.

describe.description: A stout quadrupedal creature shown in right-front three-quarter view walking to the right. It has a broad, flat, pale pinkish-tan amphibian-like head with large dark glossy eyes, small nostrils, and a wide slightly upturned mouth. Pink fleshy feathery plumes fan outward from both sides of the neck just behind the head. The back is highly arched and covered from the neck to the tail in neat overlapping rows of large rounded brown scales with paler edges. The throat, lower sides, belly, and four short stout limbs are naked wrinkled pale pink skin. Each limb ends in a splayed five-toed foot with small dark claws. A long thick tail extends to the left out of the frame, scaled dark brown above and naked pale below.
